summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) using GSD wave-based parallel execution, including creating shared cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests, and capturing staging performance baselines.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and verified (13/13 must-haves passed). Real 200-client sustained load baselines captured (0.17% error rate, 11,174 ops). BYO Pinata baselines documented with note that free tier limits were exhausted during testing.

repo: Staging Web3Auth SDK initialization takes ~22.7s — wallet button timeout in journey-timing.spec.ts needed to be increased from 20s to 45s for staging runs
Playwright config BASE_URL env var was not respected — playwright.config.ts needed explicit `process.env.BASE_URL` override with webServer conditional startup disabled when targeting staging
deleteAccountViaPage cleanup helper used hardcoded localhost:3000 API URL — needs to derive API URL from the current page URL (app-staging maps to api-staging)
vitest does not auto-load .env files — requires explicit env sourcing via shell before running (e.g., `set -a && source .env && set +a`)
Running two load test suites simultaneously against staging causes 429s even with throttle bypass — the bypass works correctly but concurrent test runs saturate the instance
Pinata free tier storage/pin limits were exhausted during BYO capacity ceiling testing — all pin operations failed with 'Plan limits exceeded', not an auth or code issue
The sdk-level load test harness (tests/load/) uses vitest with a client-pool pattern supporting stepped client escalation (50→100→200→500→1000) for capacity ceiling tests
CI throttle bypass works because NODE_ENV=test sets limits to 200/sec; staging keeps production limits — bypass header is the only mechanism to override on staging

code.finding: walletButton.waitFor timeout of 20000ms too short for staging — Web3Auth init takes ~22.7s on staging vs local
baseURL was not reading process.env.BASE_URL and webServer block needed to be conditionally disabled when BASE_URL is set to an external staging URL
API URL detection needed to derive staging API URL from page URL (replace app-staging with api-staging) rather than using hardcoded localhost
vitest does not load .env files — loadEnv is a Vite export not available in vitest context; solution is shell-level env sourcing before test runs
PinataProvider code is correct — pin failures during load test were Pinata plan quota exhaustion, not a code bug

workflow: Cherry-picking commits from worktree branches to the phase branch requires careful conflict resolution on STATE.md (always take worktree version for STATE.md conflicts)
Git worktree cleanup requires `git worktree remove --force` and sometimes manual `rm -rf` when the worktree has uncommitted changes or lock files
When debugging 'bypass header not working', eliminate concurrent test interference before suspecting env/code issues — the actual root cause here was two simultaneous load test runs
GSD decimal phases (34.1) are for work inserted mid-milestone; gap closure plans are the right mechanism when work belongs within an existing phase
Load test vitest threshold failures (exit code 1) do not mean the test produced no data — check output file directly for ops/error rates before concluding failure

friction: Cherry-picking commits from multiple worktree branches to the phase branch caused repeated STATE.md merge conflicts requiring manual resolution
Git lock files from the 34-03 retry required force-removing the stale worktree before the agent could proceed
vitest .env loading required workaround (shell sourcing) because vitest has no built-in dotenv support unlike Vite
Running BYO and sustained load tests simultaneously caused apparent throttle bypass failures — wasted significant debugging time before identifying concurrent execution as root cause
SSH access to VPS failed (exit code 255/1) blocking direct Docker env inspection — required curl-based verification instead
Pinata free tier limits exhausted during testing — BYO capacity ceiling baselines only document failure behavior, not successful pin throughput
Phase 34 was prematurely marked complete (update_roadmap ran) before load test baselines were meaningful — required discussion about whether to insert 34.1 or treat as gap closure
open_items: BYO Pinata baselines need to be recaptured with a paid/quota-reset Pinata account — current baselines only show client-side failure behavior
Sustained load test p95 thresholds (tuned for small client counts) need updating to reflect realistic 200-client expectations
Human verification item: new media test specs (streaming-playback, media-preview) need a live environment run to confirm binary stub fixtures trigger AES-CTR/GCM code paths correctly
34-04 HUMAN-UAT.md persists with status: partial and will surface in /gsd:audit-uat until the media fixture verification is completed
Add note to load test docs: always run one load test suite at a time against staging to avoid false throttle failures
The BYO load test plan doc notes Pinata quota exhaustion — someone should upgrade the Pinata test account or create a dedicated load-test account before running BYO baselines again
